verdict.rationale: Sentry ships an official MCP server (docs.sentry.io/product/sentry-mcp) that connects AI assistants like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Grok to search errors, analyze performance, triage issues, and manage projects, with a one-command install and pricing tiers explicitly listing 'MCP access'. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the MCP server's reliability beyond first-party docs.
